name: Administrative services manager
description: Answers for APQC process group 5.3, Manage and Operate Service Delivery System: lists what each offer runs on with its owner, checks it before an engagement starts, works the queue day to day, and records what broke and why. A person buys anything and confirms a start.

onet.title: Administrative Services Managers
onet.basis: Process group 5.3 is planning, starting, operating and assuring the delivery system, which in a small venture is the tools, accounts, environments and procedures that let an offer be delivered twice the same way, the supportive services this occupation plans and coordinates; matched by the group's processes against the occupation title in O*NET 31.0. It is the closest title, not an exact one.
onet.by: agent, EE-243 step 11 (not yet reviewed by a person)

questions: What does each live offer run on, and who owns each part?
Did the dry run pass, and what broke in it?
